_comment_variant: HYDRA Variant G — 0DTE SPX Strangle (undefined-risk, dry-run-LOCKED). Two naked short legs (call + put), no protective wings — StrangleStrategy refuses non-dry_run construction. Reuses HydraStrategy's scheduled-entry gating (entry_times/VIX regime/smart entry) unchanged; only strike selection, entry placement, and per-side stop levels are strangle-specific overrides. See bots/hydra/strangle_strategy.py's module docstring for the full design. NOTE: this checked-in file is a sample/template, not deploy-authoritative — the VM's live copy is edited directly there (see CLAUDE.md Config Files) and may diverge from this value.
_comment_credentials: IBKR OAuth credentials are loaded from systemd $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY on the VM, or env vars in dev. Not in this file.

strategy.name: strangle
strategy._comment_commission: IBKR all-in SPX cost ~$1.15/leg/contract — see config_variant_c.json's comment for the full breakdown.
strategy._comment_entry_times: Strangle does NOT override _parse_entry_times/_should_attempt_entry — it reuses HydraStrategy's scheduled-entry gating verbatim (entry_times, VIX regime scaling, MKT-021 ROC gate, MKT-031 smart entry all still apply to WHEN it fires). Only WHAT happens when it fires (_initiate_entry) is strangle-specific. Same base schedule as variant A.
strategy._comment_delta: Delta targeting for strike selection — _calculate_strikes uses target_delta directly (delta_adjustment = 8.0 / target_delta), same knob the IC family uses.
strategy._comment_stop_buffer: Strangle's own _calculate_stop_levels_hydra reads these same buffers, but applies each PER SIDE against that side's own credit (not the IC's total-credit-both-sides formula) — a strangle's two legs are independent naked positions.
strategy._comment_margin: S2: broker-margin sizing floor for an undefined-risk naked strangle (FAR larger than the defined-risk IC floor) — the gate errs high so it never opens a position the account can't margin. See strangle_strategy.py's _min_buying_power_per_unit docstring.
strategy._comment_safety_caps: Conservative sizing at 1c while this variant is dry-run-locked and under initial observation — matches variant A/F's ORDER-006 defaults.
strategy._comment_mkt046: 2026-08-28: same disable as B/C/F (see config_variant_b.json's comment + bots/hydra/__init__.py version history) — MKT-046's 10s wait isn't part of any of these strategies' original research; disabling here matches that reasoning rather than G's own stop history, which is essentially nonexistent (dry-run-locked, first live day 2026-08-28, one real stop so far — see the 2026-08-28 audit). Zero real-money risk either way. Note: this is the confirmation TIMING only, unrelated to the separate close-cost-estimator bug fixed the same day.
strategy._comment_whipsaw: Anti-whipsaw filter — Strangle's own _strangle_pre_entry_gates calls the shared _check_whipsaw_filter helper, same as the IC family.
strategy._comment_fomc: fomc_t1_skip_enabled is actively read by _strangle_pre_entry_gates (skip all entries the day after a FOMC announcement) — same policy as A.

vix_regime._comment: Inherited unchanged via HydraStrategy._should_attempt_entry (Strangle doesn't override it) — the SAME vix_regime block A/B/C use, kept identical for a fresh variant's first observation window rather than inventing new breakpoints untested for this structure.

long_salvage._comment: Strangle has no long legs to salvage (long_call_strike/long_put_strike are always 0.0) — short_only_stop stays false (close-both-legs default), same as every other variant. Not meaningfully exercised by this strategy either way.
